# Support

Start with the documentation for your task:

- [Deployment](../docs/deployment.md): installation, administrator bootstrap, health checks, and backups.
- [Product guide](../docs/product-guide.md): workspace setup and customer workflows.
- [Integrations](../docs/integrations.md): model providers, delivery gateways, and callbacks.
- [Upgrades](../docs/upgrade.md): migrations, recovery, and data preservation.

For a reproducible defect or a product improvement, search [existing issues](https://github.com/ZerothLab/intent-crm/issues) and then use the appropriate issue template. For a usage question that the guides do not answer, open a question issue with your intended workflow and the relevant documentation section.

Include the commit or image digest, deployment method, expected result, and a minimal example. Remove credentials, tokens, customer records, private hostnames, and identifying information from logs and screenshots. Never attach an entire environment file or database dump.

Community support is provided as maintainers and contributors are available. There is no guaranteed response time. Use the [security policy](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities.
